Controls (4e)

Each pair is the same component with two colours for "on": A is brass (the primary colour), B is the second accent (as the selected tab button uses). Sizes follow the fields: small 14px, medium 18px, large 22px. The box is the hit target's centre; the whole label is clickable.

A · Brass

Small
Medium

B · Second accent

Small

Proposed rule: a switch turns something on or off right away (an effect, a setting). A checkbox marks or picks items (MEM, Extra attack, options in a list), often several.

Page tabs

A · Brass underline, brass label

B · Second-accent underline, text label

Page tabs switch between views of a page. Picking one of a few options inside a card stays the tab buttons (Main / Off).
